title: Kazimierczuk PWM DC-DC Power Converters Source Metadata

sections.heading: Current-mode control modeling
sections.text: Current-mode control transforms the plant from second-order to first-order by making the inductor current follow the control signal. Subharmonic instability above 50% duty cycle requires slope compensation with ramp slope >= inductor downslope / 2.

sections.heading: CCM-DCM unified models
sections.text: The CCM/DCM boundary occurs at a load current that depends on the inductor value, duty cycle, and switching frequency. Below the boundary, the plant transfer function changes from second-order to first-order, requiring different compensator design.
